messages:
Katie L: Quick handoff — I'm handing primary to Ben for the night. Two things active that you should know about.

incident-bot: ALERT INC-9431: embeddings-p99-latency spike in eu-west (detected 23:08 UTC). Severity: SEV3. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings, /v1/batch-emb.

Katie L: Summary: eu-west embeddings p99 jumped from ~210ms to 2.4s around 22:55 UTC. Error rate small but visible (5% 5xx on batch path). Likely KV eviction + slow cold hosts.

Katie L: What I've done so far:
- scaled embeddings pool prim -> 6 replicas (was 3)
- bumped prefetch worker concurrency from 8 -> 16 on eu-west-primary
- toggled caching ttl from 60s -> 300s for hot prefixes (temp)
- switched routing policy to favor warmed secondaries for non-critical customers

Katie L: commands run:```bash
# scale embeddings deployment
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/embeddings-eu --replicas=6
# update prefetch config (k8s cm)
kubectl -n inference patch cm/prefetch-config -p '{"data":{"concurrency":"16"}}'
```

Ben R: noted. Any customer-facing impact?

Katie L: Small for most customers — internal synthetic load and a few enterprise customers reported higher latency on batch endpoints. No major error-rate increase on generative text endpoints. CI test flagged 2 customers with >300ms regressions on embeddings.

Maria S: I put a quick monitor on the two affected customers and DM'd cs. They'll throttle batch size on their side if it persists. CS asked for ETA on recovery.

Jamal K: Can you paste the runbook pointer?

Katie L: Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ONCALL/pages/EV/kv-cache-eviction-runbook (section: 'embeddings prefetched hotset')

Katie L: Also an ongoing secondary issue: tokenstore throttle alerts in us-east (INC-9433) — token write latency spike tied to a noisy bulk indexing job. Mitigation in progress: rate-limit the bulk job, increase DB connection pool for tokenstore.

incident-bot: ALERT INC-9433: tokenstore-write-latency spike in us-east (detected 23:12 UTC). Severity: SEV3.

Ben R: OK I'll take primary. I'm on-call at my desk for the next 8 hours. I'll keep prim/sec ownership until 07:00 UTC. Katie — thanks for the notes. I'm going to:
- verify scale succeeded and pods are healthy
- watch p99 and 5xx dashboards for eu-west
- coordinate with infra to confirm KV eviction rates

Ben R: Quick checklist I'm running through now:
1) confirm replicas READY (kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embeddings)
2) check instance warmup / cache hit ratio (grafana: embeddings.cache.hit_ratio)
3) ensure routing change reverted if stable (we should revert to normal routing after stability)

Ben R: Running health checks...

oncall-bot: k8s: replicas updated for deploy/embeddings-eu -> 6 (23:23 UTC) :white_check_mark:

Ben R: Pod status looks good, warmup happening but p99 still ~1.1s (down from 2.4s). Cache hit ratio bumped from 18% -> 61% after TTL change.

Ben R: I asked infra to look at possible noisy hosts causing K/V eviction; infra says one host in eu-west-2 had memory pressure and some pods got OOMKilled earlier. They are rebalancing.

Maria S: CS confirmed they saw transient errors; they've asked we keep them posted and flagged a low-severity incident to their account team.

Jamal K: On tokenstore: I paused the bulk indexing job at 23:18 UTC. Tokenstore p99 dropped from 900ms -> 120ms. I'm watching.

Ben R: Good catch Jamal. Keep it paused until infra completes rebalancing.

Katie L: Coverage notes: I'm leaving the bridge open for the first hour in case anything regresses. Primary: Ben R. Secondary: Jamal K. If both offline, escalate to Maria S.

Katie L: Known gaps: no dedicated embed-rewarm playbook in the handbook for multi-tenant routing — I've left a short checklist in the runbook page. We should create a permanent runbook item.

Ben R: Ack. I'll file a short postmortem doc in /incidents/INC-9431 and add the embedding rewarm play.

Ben R: Immediate priorities for tonight:
- keep an eye on p99 and 5xx for embeddings (eu-west)
- don't revert TTL change until p99 < 350ms for 10m window
- keep tokenstore bulk jobs paused until rebalancing finishes and p99 < 200ms

Maria S: I'll handle customer comms updates and track which customers need rate-limited batch windows.

Ben R: If anything spikes again, escalate to on-call-sre and ping me directly @Ben R.

oncall-bot: scheduled handoff reminder set. Next check-in requested at 00:15 UTC.

Katie L: Quick note on metrics to watch (dashboards):
- grafana: /dash/embeddings-eu/latency (p50/p95/p99)
- grafana: embeddings.cache.hit_ratio
- ops: tokenstore.write.latency by host
- logs: /logs - filter: service:embeddings severity:ERROR

Ben R: Thanks. I'm taking over now. Leaving thread open for updates. :thumbsup:

Maria S: Thanks Katie — leaving CS handover notes in the incident doc. Will rejoin if CS escalates.

Jamal K: monitoring tokenstore and infra rebalancer. Will update if anything changes.

Ben R: last check 23:48 UTC — p99 down to 420ms, errors dropping. Keeping TTL change and replicas until stable for 30m window.

Ben R: (23:58 UTC) marking handoff-onwatch; next handoff due 07:00 UTC.

end of thread
